youtube.title: Opposites for Kids! ⬆️⬇️ Up and Down, Fast and Slow | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Duck presses a silly button and Robo becomes Opposite Robo: he does the opposite of everything! Learn six pairs of opposites at the playground: up and down, fast and slow, open and closed, full and empty, loud and quiet, and stop and go. Then help fix Robo with the stop and go game.

Try it at home with a grown-up: play Opposite Me. The grown-up says stand up, and the child sits down. Go fast, and the child goes slow. Then swap! Play in a clear space: fast means fast feet in place.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Oh no! Robo is Opposite Robo!
He does the opposite of what we say!
Let's learn the opposites first. To the seesaw!
Duck goes up. Frog goes down.
Now Frog goes up. Duck goes down.
A frog can jump many times its own length!
Reach up high. Squat down low!
He went down! Up, down. Flip-flop!
Here comes Frog. Frog is fast!
Zoom! The cheetah is the fastest animal on land.
Sloths are so slow, little plants grow in their fur!
Run fast in place! Now slow motion.
The toy box is open. Now it is closed.
Open your hands. Close your hands!
Plop, plop, plop. Now it is full!
He tipped it out! Now it is empty.
Not a whisper! Loud, quiet. Flip-flop!
We want Robo at the button. Say the opposite!
To make Opposite Robo go, say... stop!
Robo is at the button! Freeze!
Opposite quiz! One. What is the opposite of up?
Two. What is the opposite of fast?
Three. The bucket is full. What is the opposite?
Four. What is the opposite of stop?
Now I will press the button again!
Up, down. Fast, slow. Open, closed. Flip-flop!
Full, empty. Loud, quiet. Stop, go. Flip-flop!
Opposites are as different as can be. Bye-bye!
